shine.vulkan_onboarding.title: Try Vulkan Rendering?
shine.vulkan_onboarding.message: Shine supports Minecraft's Vulkan renderer, which may improve performance on supported systems. Would you like to switch? A restart is required.
shine.vulkan_onboarding.restart_message: Restart Minecraft to apply the renderer change.
